text.zh: 成名之战，对方前锋单刀杀到，全世界都在看你……
text.en: Your breakout match — a striker bears down one-on-one, the world watching…

label.zh: 鬼魅出击，把球和人一起没收
label.en: Rush out and smother ball and man together

note.zh: 弃门出击、像清道夫一样冲出禁区解围 —— 致敬「门卫」诺伊尔
note.en: Rushing out to sweep up behind the defence like a libero — homage to 'sweeper-keeper' Neuer

background.zh: 诺伊尔把门将踢成了「门卫」——频繁出击像清道夫一样参与防守和组织，重新定义了现代门将。
background.en: Neuer turned the goalkeeper into a 'sweeper-keeper', rushing out like a libero — redefining the modern keeper.

label.zh: 稳稳封住角度，化解必进球
label.en: Hold your angle, calmly deny a certain goal

label.zh: 弃门狂奔到中线……球被吊进空门
label.en: Sprint to halfway… and get lobbed into your empty net

text.zh: 成名之战，你在中圈拿球，面前是整条防线……
text.en: Your breakout match — you get the ball at halfway, a whole defence ahead…

label.zh: 带球连过五人吊射空门
label.en: Dribble past five and dink it in

note.zh: 致敬马拉多纳 / 梅西的世纪进球
note.en: The Goal of the Century — Maradona / Messi

background.zh: 1986 年世界杯，马拉多纳从中场连过 5 名英格兰球员破门，被誉为「世纪进球」；2007 年梅西对赫塔菲几乎完美复刻。
background.en: 1986 World Cup: Maradona dribbled past five England players from midfield — the 'Goal of the Century'. Messi nearly recreated it vs Getafe in 2007.

label.zh: 一脚长传助攻队友，不抢风头
label.en: A first-time long ball to set up a teammate

label.zh: 油炸丸子+彩虹过人，过了就完事、不射
label.en: Nutmegs and rainbow flicks — beat them all, then don't shoot

note.zh: 「油炸丸子」「彩虹过人」都是华丽的炫技过人动作 —— 致敬快乐足球的罗纳尔迪尼奥
note.en: Elastico and rainbow flicks — flashy show-off dribbles — homage to joga-bonito Ronaldinho

background.zh: 罗纳尔迪尼奥以油炸丸子、牛尾巴等花式动作闻名，把足球踢成了表演，是「快乐足球」的代名词。
background.en: Ronaldinho's elasticos and flip-flaps turned football into theatre — the very meaning of 'joga bonito'.

label.zh: 过了五个，第六个把球捅出底线，喜提五大囧
label.en: Beat five, then poke it out for a throw-in. Blooper reel.
